items.summary: Citius Oncology, Inc. ("Citius Oncology") (Nasdaq: CTOR), an oncology‑focused biopharmaceutical company and majority‑owned subsidiary of Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Citius Pharma") (Nasdaq: CTXR), today announced positive topline safety and efficacy results from an investigator‑initiated Phase 1 trial evaluating LYMPHIR™ (E7777, denileukin diftitox‑cxdl) administered prior to commercial CD19‑directed CAR‑T therapy in patients with high‑risk relapsed or refractory diffuse large B‑cell lymphoma (DLBCL). The trial was conducted by lead investigator, Dr. Veronika Bachanova, at the University of Minnesota and City of Hope. Full results were presented at the 2026 ASTCT ® CIBMTR ® Tandem Meetings 1 .
